comparison.objective: Break and recover insert tangs; record routes a curved board edge using a starting pin and bearing.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs small-scale coaxial impact work; record braces and pivots a board onto a bearing, then controls directional feed while maintaining cutter clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and recovered fragments without damage; record requires sufficient routed length, correct pin-assisted entry/feed direction, safe hand clearance, and board clear of the cutter. Candidate numeric damage limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Machine-feed path control around a curved workpiece is meaningfully different from notch fracture and debris recovery.
